rows.exact_result: HISTORICAL_CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED: original A->B ~1.879 bpm (~20.6% relative, sometimes miscited as ~23%) used Model A (8,065 params) vs Model B (28,865/29,089 params) - NOT capacity-matched. Capacity control (docs/PPG_DALIA_CAPACITY_CONTROL_PREDECLARATION.md) found ~68% of this gap is recovered by capacity/architecture alone (A_cap). The GOVERNING capacity-controlled result is: A_cap->B ~0.605 bpm, C->B ~0.776 bpm, both 5/5 seeds (results/ppg_dalia_capacity_control.json). Per docs/FURKAN_PAPER_HANDOFF_CANONICAL_DAY9.md: do NOT write 20.6%/23% pure IMU, 1.88 bpm clean IMU, or a 59/41 causal split.

The original ~20.6%/23% figure is historical and capacity-confounded - never cite it as a clean IMU effect.
